scope.summary: Repository-wide read-only security audit of current revision.
artifactsReviewed: backend and frontend product source, Docker Compose, nginx configuration
scope.runtimeStatus: Static offline source review in progress.
limitations: Independent architecture and focused investigations still running.

threatModel.summary: Public customer and signup APIs cross into Spring services and PostgreSQL; authenticated administrators cross JWT and DB membership boundaries; nginx/cloudflared mediate client identity; AI sends aggregate store context to a configured provider.
attackerCapabilities: Unauthenticated caller with public QR token
targeted caller knowing a customer phone number or bearer token
securityObjectives: Prevent client-chosen game results and duplicate redemption
assumptions: Static review only; deployment-specific exposure requires stated configuration prerequisites.

candidate.title: Unauthenticated game creation permits persistent database exhaustion and store-wide denial of service
counterevidence: Length bounds and idempotency do not bound fresh phones and keys.

candidate.title: Public signup performs amplified provisioning without throttling
counterevidence: Uniqueness checks do not bound attacker-created identities.

candidate.title: Cloudflare field-test topology collapses all clients into one in-memory rate-limit identity
counterevidence: Nginx overwrites caller-supplied X-Real-IP but uses the cloudflared container address.

candidate.title: Prize CSV export permits spreadsheet formula injection
counterevidence: Requires authorized prize editor and a separate user opening the export.

openQuestions: Independent architecture and auth/business-logic investigation pending.
